about: The Mixamo clips the cinematic uses (tools/cinematic/retarget_mixamo.py; npm run build-cinematic-clips). Paths are under `source` (build/mixamo/, the downloads: FBX Binary, without skin, 30 fps; never committed). `rest` is the skinned X Bot whose bind pose is Mixamo's rest. Each clip: its name in assets/cinematic/soldier_clips.glb, its file, `trim` [from, to] seconds of it kept (none: all of it, so the film's times are the download's own), `loops` to repeat a cycle (a run) carrying him on, and `use`: what the film uses it for (tools/cinematic/README.md has the takes, trims and grips). `candidates` are the other downloads, built only with --candidates (for looking at them).

clips.name: sprint
clips.use: the run in: one 0.533 s stride cycle, 8 times (4.27 s, 23 m)

clips.name: dive
clips.use: the dive to his left and the mid-air snatch (right hand), landing, rolling over and coming up

clips.name: cover
clips.use: kneeling behind the barrier, gun low (right knee down)

clips.name: cover_aim
clips.use: kneeling, gun up in both hands (the pop-up's first frame); also the right hand's grip for the snatch

clips.name: pop_up
clips.use: rising from the knee to standing, aiming

clips.name: fire
clips.use: standing two-handed, one shot with its recoil

clips.name: spare_dive_roll
clips.use: spare: a forward dive roll from a run, aiming before and after

clips.name: enemy_aim
clips.use: the enemy before the shot: standing, aiming a pistol, still (loops)

clips.name: enemy_hit_fall
clips.use: the enemy struck in the shoulder: twists and falls
